text:
Jordan (PM): Heads-up: compiling the GA handoff packet for the upcoming inference feature. Need firm owners for SLA wording, ops escalation, concierge pilot staffing, pricing guardrails, and final perf validation. Can folks claim items and flag blockers?
Ravi (Eng): I'll take ops escalation playbook + fallback routing. Will sketch autoscale limits and a short failure-mode checklist. Target: tomorrow morning.
Sam (SRE): I'll take SLA wording and the runbook acceptance checklist. Quick question: do we publish percentile SLAs publicly or keep precise numbers internal and only give ranges?
Jordan (PM): My recommendation: publish high-level commitments (e.g., "99th percentile latency target") and keep the detailed per-route percentiles in internal docs. That reduces legal surface while still being transparent.
Lena (Support): Concierge pilot needs 2 primary contacts + 1 floater for the first 10 business days. I also want a dedicated Slack channel and a short onboarding template for participating customers. Need FinOps signoff for OT.
Marcus (FinOps): OT OK within a pilot contingency fund. I need projected QPS and token mix to model burn. Jordan, can you paste conservative and optimistic usage curves?
Jordan (PM): Conservative steady QPS 30, conservative peak 120. Optimistic steady 60, peak 240. Avg token/req ~75, occasional long sessions to 2,500 tokens. I'll add a small spreadsheet to the doc.
Priya (Docs): I'll author the public FAQ, internal runbook, and the concierge onboarding email. Decision: public SLA high-level language + link to "internal SLA appendix" that lists exact metrics. Need Legal to approve phrasing.
Olivia (Security): I'll draft a short KMS/data-residency blurb for Private customers and note the SOC audit lead time (~6 weeks). Priya — I can drop a two-paragraph stub in 48h.
Ravi (Eng): Risk: we haven't locked the quantized model profile for Dedicated; that will change latency/cost curves. Mitigation: flag SLA as "subject to final perf sweep" and include fallback variant that is already verified.
Sam (SRE): Runbook snippet for paging platform-oncall (please include exactly):
```
/ops page --service inference-runtime --severity P1 --summary "GA customer-facing outage"
```
Make sure the runbook copies verbatim.
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/ga-handoff/3965439876  Jordan (PM) created the doc.
Marcus (FinOps): Once we have Ravi's finalized perf numbers we can lock price guardrails. Please model both the "quantization realized" and "quantization delayed" scenarios. That feeds billing thresholds and daily cost alerts.
Lena (Support): For billing disputes during pilot: FinOps triages, Support handles customer comms. We need a one-paragraph playbook saying who replies and within what SLA. Priya, can you insert a template?
Priya (Docs): On it. I'll add the dispute template, sample messages, and a short triage checklist. Also adding a short ops checklist for first-7-days monitoring.
Ravi (Eng): Request: schedule a 96-hour burst test on Dedicated hardware before we finalize SLA numbers. Eng-QA, can you slot that? rachel-qa?
rachel-qa: I can run the 96h test next week. Need a final test matrix from Eng (latency percentiles, mem pressure, KV miss scenarios).
Sam (SRE): Monitoring thresholds proposed: cost alert if daily burn > forecast +20%, sustained 5m error-rate >0.5% triggers paging, cache miss rate spike >25% pages to platform-oncall. Also add a synthetic test failure alert for long-tail token sessions >180s.
Marcus (FinOps): Add finance alert flow: if daily cost > forecast then post to #finops-alerts and send a digest to billing@redwood.com. Priya — include alert copy and recipients in docs.
Lena (Support): Concierge channel ops: daily 10am stand for first week, then MWF check-ins for next 3 weeks. Also request: a short handoff checklist for customers leaving the pilot.
Jordan (PM): Blockers I'm tracking: (A) quantization profile final (Ravi) ETA 48h, (B) 96h perf sweep scheduled (rachel-qa) ETA 72h, (C) budget OT approval (Marcus) ETA EOD tomorrow, (D) public SLA wording legal review (Priya + Legal) ETA 3 days, (E) KMS/residency blurb (Olivia) ETA 48h. If you have different ETAs, update the doc.
Ravi (Eng): Marking quantization as high risk. If delayed we'll default to "verified variant + autoscale" fallback and increase reserved burst capacity.
Olivia (Security): Noted. SOC audit lead time ~6 weeks if a customer requests proof. KMS paragraph ready in 48h.
Priya (Docs): I'll keep the public wording intentionally vague and provide an internal appendix. Will coordinate with Legal today.
Marcus (FinOps): I'll run the optimistic/conservative burn models and post numbers by tomorrow EOD.
Jordan (PM): Thanks. Please drop a one-line ETA in the doc and add any sub-owners. I'll consolidate and post a final owner list Friday morning. If anyone hits a blocker, DM me. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng): ETA added.
Priya (Docs): Templates uploaded, WIP public wording in draft.
Lena (Support): Rota posted and concierge Slack channel created.
Sam (SRE): Runbook draft uploaded under internal docs. Please review for missing escalation steps.
Jordan (PM): Closing thread  will publish the consolidated handoff when complete. If urgent, ping me directly.
